sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B: Video-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-27B is a 27-billion-parameter dense language model with integrated vision capabilities, built by Qwen on the architectural foundation of Qwen3.5. This causal language model with vision encoder supports native image and video understanding, making it suitable for multimodal reasoning tasks that require understanding both textual and visual information.
